description: EXPLORE REGISTRY EVIDENCE for a condition. Returns descriptive counts and alphabetical candidate examples, not efficacy or a treatment sequence. score and plausibility are null. NEXT: twin_experiment_guide and run_twin_experiment for explicit reaction-model simulation, or post_reality_request to obtain measurements.

condition.description: The condition to model, e.g. glioblastoma.

cycles.description: Deprecated alias of examples, kept for older clients. examples wins when both are sent.

examples.description: How many alphabetical candidate examples to return, 1 to 3 (default 3).

name: simulate_twin
